item.title: Eri
item.description:
Fourteen at the story’s start. A defiant punk – outwardly confident, practical, observant, dry. Secretly the princess of Kraeta.

She refuses to stay blind.

Beyond

Daughter of King Lachesis and Queen Hren. Her father set an anchor on her forehead at age four; it is what unlocks the blink.

item.title: King Lachesis
item.description:
King of Kraeta. Eri’s father. Cold and distant on the surface; a fierce, hidden love underneath – a lock of her hair, birthday letters never sent.

Beyond

He holds the Golden Path and saw that Eri was the only thread that defeats the unicorns. He engineered everything to armour her against Rhodes’s paradise: the anchor, the hard life, the pirate years. He is trapped in a void bubble mid-book.

item.title: Rhodes
item.description:
A unicorn. Beautiful and terrible.

Beyond

The beauty is an illusion over a true rotting form. His weapon is paradise – temptation, never force; he holds that a soul coerced does not count. He deploys beasts as enforcers, lies to Eri about her mother, and cranks the drain to punish her. Issah kills him; the illusion collapses to rot.
